The Architect may accept, reject, modify, or defer those proposals before confirming the resulting intent and scope. Any conflict is surfaced explicitly before semantic confirmation. If the Architect proposes to proceed despite a permitted conflict, SAGE requires an evidence-backed exception decision that records the governing authority, rationale, affected controls, scope, blast radius, residual risk, compensating controls, and reconciliation and verification obligations. Claims that can be proven deterministically must be proven before executable planning; claims supported only by evidence must remain evidence-qualified; unresolved uncertainty must remain explicit.
